verdict.rationale: The App SDK docs show a first-party `attio` command (`attio migrate folder-structure`), which indicates an official CLI exists for app development. The SDK guide also says new apps come bootstrapped with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files for AI-assisted development. However, the evidence is a single command mention, and its scope appears limited to SDK app tooling. Missing for 10: documented CLI install/usage reference, a command set beyond the migration command, CLI access to workspace data/records for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Every new app comes bootstrapped with a default AGENTS.md file. We additionally supply a CLAUDE.md file to provide instructions for Claude Code users.
